snippet.title: Northern Isle preview
snippet.description:
Platform:  PC   Release date: TBA
Wishlist: store.steampowered.com/app/2541950/Sirens/

Sirens is an underwater exploration and narrative-driven game where freedom of movement and emotional connection to the world matter more than checklists, quests, and numbers. Simply swimming and discovering secrets is not enough. We want the player to feel like a part of the ocean, to have a real impact on it, and to experience an environment that reacts to their actions in a natural, organic way.


MAIN FEATURES
- Exploration of sea and ocean waters
- Story Narrative
- Main Hub customization
- Mermaid customization
- Combat using melee weapons
- Boss battles
